intro.text: Waste Energy Corp. (“Waste Energy,” “we,” “us,” “our,” or the “Company”) is an early-stage clean-energy company focused on converting non-recyclable waste tires and plastics into usable fuel, reusable commodities, and renewable energy products. We are engaged in the development and commercial deployment of a waste conversion technology platform that uses a thermal process operating in an oxygen-restricted environment to break down waste tires and plastic materials at elevated temperatures, producing valuable byproducts without combustion.
